scope.summary: W4 external-client cases for the dictionary tools (list_schemas, schema_inspect, describe, describe_index, describe_trigger, describe_view, sample_rows, read_clob, plscope_inspect; scripts/e2e/w4/cases/dictionary-tools.json, 41 cases) green over stdio and Streamable HTTP on FREE 23ai, XE 21 and XE 18, with per-case isolated fixtures (df03922d rework) so expectations hold both alone and in the family.
out_of_scope: ADB behaviour and unlisted behaviours, per the bead's no-claim.
oraclemcp-euxm0 (read_clob LOB alias vs column-name masking rules; masked today via mask_unknown_default).

entry_points.name: W4 dictionary-tools family, release binary (verifier re-execution)
entry_points.trace: Release binary from a clean export of 12e16ecb; driver invoked with every dictionary-tools case id: free23 82/82, xe21 82/82, xe18 82/82 (stdio + http). Alone on free23 (stdio + http): the five reworked cases w4_schema_inspect_object_inventory_exact, w4_schema_inspect_object_type_filter, w4_schema_inspect_pagination_cursor, w4_sample_rows_types_exact_values, w4_search_objects_detail_names_only, plus negatives w4_describe_view_missing_object_not_found and w4_sample_rows_view_with_side_effecting_function_refused -> all pass. Blockers brsya, mo1ld, 74jzy, i1k2q, .8.5 are closed.

entry_points.name: expectation review
entry_points.trace: 02512dea (leaked-state expectations) was superseded by df03922d: listing/search cases now create and drop their own D7I_/D7V_/D7P_/D7S_ objects and filter by that prefix; expected sets are re-read from ALL_OBJECTS. sample_rows T_TYPES truncated=true is legitimate in isolation: the T4.3 fixture seeds T_TYPES with several rows, so max_rows=1 cuts the result (the oraclemcp-74jzy fix), and the case passes alone.

limitations: The isolation rework narrowed w4_schema_inspect_object_inventory_exact from a nine-object multi-type inventory (INDEX/PACKAGE/PACKAGE BODY/TABLE/FUNCTION/VIEW) to three objects (FUNCTION/TABLE/VIEW); it is still exact and DB re-read, but covers fewer object types.
Tier-C runner was not used; each lane was driven directly with the scoped family in one invocation.

known_defects.description: oracle_read_clob aliases the LOB to LOB_VALUE so column-name masking rules never match it; masked only by mask_unknown_default.
